name: Bidi
summary: Isolates each Latin run inside Arabic copy, so sentence punctuation stays at the logical end of the line.
useWhen: Arabic copy with a Latin term in it: a product name, a file name, a format such as JSON, a URL
A sentence that ends right after a Latin word and shows its period on the wrong side
avoidWhen: English copy: it comes back unchanged, so the wrapper adds nothing
Copy with markup inside: Bidi takes plain text only
A whole paragraph in another language: use a nested Theme with its lang

a11y.focus: Never focusable. It adds no role.
notes: Each run is a bdi element with dir ltr. A run that opens with neutrals, like ~/.cursor, gets an explicit direction instead of a guess.
No invisible marks (RLM, LRM, U+202A to U+202E) are typed into strings: the markup sets the direction.

react.note: Lives in packages/react/src/theme/Bidi.tsx. The splitting is splitLatinRuns in @the-system/shared.

angular.note: A pipe or a component on splitLatinRuns from @the-system/shared.

native.note: Text runs with writingDirection from splitLatinRuns.

mistakes.wrong: Typing an LRM mark after a Latin word in an Arabic string
mistakes.right: <Bidi>{text}</Bidi>, which wraps the run in bdi

mistakes.wrong: Wrapping the period in the isolate with the Latin word
mistakes.right: Let Bidi find the run: it never takes trailing punctuation
